message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that give you at least three consecutive days off).  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the following Monday is observed, which usually creates the long weekend.)

| Holiday | Calendar date (2023) | Observed (if needed) | Long‑weekend days (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
|---------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Family Day** (most provinces) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** |
| **Christmas** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** |

### Quick notes

* **New Year’s Day** fell on Sunday Jan 1, so it was observed on Monday Jan 2.  That gives you a 2‑day break (Sunday Jan 1–Monday Jan 2) rather than a full 3‑day long weekend.  
* Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that can also create long weekends.  If you need province‑specific data, let me know!  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or need province‑specific long weekends, just let me know!
